items.title: George Wein interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Anybody with the name of Monk can’t be all bad.

ctx.x: George was interviewed in New York City on January 13, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe. We are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in New York City. I’m especially pleased that George Wein has found a little time for me today, and I’m most appreciative.
Anybody with the name of Monk can’t be all bad.
